And Award Compensation As Claimed In The Claim

This Appeal Coming On For Reporting Settlement,
This Day, Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:
Coram :

Hon'Ble Mr. Justice E.S.Indiresh
 Oral Judgment

This appeal is arising out of the judgment and award dated 26.03.2015 in MVC No.1299/2014 on the file of the Member, MACT and Presiding Officer, Fast Track Court, Vijayapur, partly allowing the claim petition and awarding compensation to the claimants.

2. Sri G.B. Yadav, learned counsel appearing for the appellant contended that, the liability has been fixed NC: 2026:KHC-K:886 HC-KAR on the appellant-owner of the vehicle in question (respondent No.1 before the Tribunal) and the parties have settled the claim petition among themselves.
3. Recording the submission made by the learned counsel appearing for the appellant, the appeal is disposed of.
4. The amount in deposit, if any, is ordered to be refunded to the appellant on due identification.
